posts.title: AI Took My Excuses
posts.description: I wrote that AI leaves you with zero excuses and meant it as good news. The darker half took me longer. If the excuse is gone and you still don't move, it was never the excuse stopping you.

posts.title: Honest Feedback Is a Fear Problem
posts.description: Most communication problems on teams aren't communication problems. They're somebody being scared to tell somebody else the truth.

posts.title: Fear Is the Compass
posts.description: Most advice treats fear as the thing in your way. I treat it as a compass. The bigger the fear, the more I know to work on it.
